text: I'm a little late to the whole Movember conversation, but this year we're still taking on a challenge. Just because I haven't posted it doesn't mean I haven't been doing it.
30 kilo weight vest, same as last year,
so walking up the hill, walking down the hill obviously, 30 kilos on my back, at least one hill every day for the whole month of Movember, and calling it Heavyweight Hills.
It's a physical challenge, but as always, there's a bigger reason behind it.
It's a memory of someone special. I lost my uncle last year, and in the last three months, I've lost two grandparents.
And it's there to help raise awareness for men's health, men's mental health specifically,
because we all carry weight, just some of it is invisible.
So the weight vest is there to help symbolize the weight that men hold on their shoulders, except this time it's visible.
So this month, let's make sure no one has to carry that weight alone.
